headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: DepthFeed API key as 'Bearer df_…' (from https://depthfeed.com). Omit to use the keyless demo tier (BTC + Polymarket, top-of-book).

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: DepthFeed API key as 'Bearer df_…' (from https://depthfeed.com). Omit to use the keyless demo tier (BTC + Polymarket, top-of-book).

toolsPreview.name: polymarket_all_markets
toolsPreview.description: Paid data plan required. Return every active Polymarket market across all categories, not only crypto. AI execution credits do not unlock this export. The text result is one LLM-readable line per market: MARKET_NAME | OUTCOME PRICES | DEADLINE | MARKET_ID. The sweep fails closed if complete pagination cannot be verified and includes timestamp, count, source-page count, and SHA-256.

toolsPreview.name: polymarket_search_markets
toolsPreview.description: List Polymarket up/down crypto prediction markets for a coin. Returns market id, slug, window, status and timing. Use the returned id/slug with polymarket_get_market or polymarket_get_snapshots.

toolsPreview.name: polymarket_get_market
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a single Polymarket market by id (market_id) or by slug. Provide exactly one of market_id or slug.

toolsPreview.name: polymarket_get_snapshots
toolsPreview.description: Historical order-book snapshots (time series) for one Polymarket market. Use interval to downsample and include_orderbook for the full ladder. History depth is gated by plan.

toolsPreview.name: kalshi_search_markets
toolsPreview.description: List Kalshi crypto markets (full yes/no depth, DepthFeed-exclusive). Requires a paid plan; keyless/Free returns a 402 upsell.

toolsPreview.name: kalshi_get_orderbook
toolsPreview.description: Latest yes/no order-book depth for a Kalshi market by ticker. Requires a paid plan.

toolsPreview.name: kalshi_get_snapshots
toolsPreview.description: Historical yes/no depth snapshots for a Kalshi market by ticker. Requires a paid plan; history gated by plan window.

toolsPreview.name: kalshi_get_candles
toolsPreview.description: Hourly OHLC candles (yes bid, yes ask, traded price) plus volume and open interest for a Kalshi market. This is the only history that exists for non-crypto Kalshi markets — Kalshi serves no historical order book — and it reaches back up to a year, far past the order-book capture. `price` is null in periods with no trade. Requires a paid plan; history gated by plan window.

toolsPreview.name: limitless_search_markets
toolsPreview.description: List currently-open Limitless (Base CLOB) markets, DepthFeed-exclusive. Requires a paid plan.

toolsPreview.name: limitless_get_orderbook
toolsPreview.description: Latest L2 depth (bids desc / asks asc) for a Limitless market by slug. Requires a paid plan.

toolsPreview.name: limitless_get_snapshots
toolsPreview.description: Historical L2 depth snapshots (time series) for a Limitless market by slug. Requires a paid plan; history gated by plan window.

toolsPreview.name: screener
toolsPreview.description: Cross-venue top-of-book snapshot for all assets across Polymarket, Kalshi, and Binance — a one-shot overview of the current state. No arguments.

toolsPreview.name: whoami
toolsPreview.description: Show the current session's plan, rate limits, history window, and coin access (reflects keyless demo vs. your API key).
